title: Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
body:
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Apka pyara nawasa karbala me lutgaya
Kya bhula baithi thi ummat aayaye tatheer ko
mezbaa'n bankar bulaaya mehmaa'n shabbir ko Kyu musalmaa'n hoke phir mehmaan ko dhoka diya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Raahe haq me goud ke paalo piya ghar dediya
bayyate fasiq na ki haq ke liye sar dediya
sar magar islam ka shabbir ne uncha kiya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahle haq batil ki taqat se kabhi darte nahi
jiska maslik ho shahadat wo kabhi marte nahi
hum hussaini waale hai duniya hame samjhi hai kya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
role tu bhi uske gham me aye dile qasta jigar
jinke gham me roraha hai aaj tak jin o bashar
wo hasan ki jaan aur zehra ka dilbar lutgaya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala me sar kataaya fatima ke laal ne
aasiyou ko baqshwaaya fatima ke laal ne
waqte aaqir zeere khanjar shukr ka sajda kiya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khuda ki zaat par jo khoum me de ye yaqeen
kasrate aatish hargis khouf khasakte nahi
aaj bhi leti hai duniya imtehaa to kya kiya
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Isko kehte hai saqawat sabr iska naam hai
haq parasto ke liye istar se ek paighamm hai
kar sada nalou se ruswa ye sabaq humko mila
<<MINI>>
Ya rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah
